Dashboard/Index.title: Dashboard
Dashboard/Index.en: A quick look at how the business is doing today: sales, top products and what needs attention.
Dashboard/Index.tl: Mabilisang tingin kung kumusta ang negosyo ngayong araw: benta, mabentang produkto, at mga dapat asikasuhin.
ask: How are sales today?

Sales/Index.title: Sales
Sales/Index.en: The cash register. Add products to the order, take payment and print the receipt.
Sales/Index.tl: Ito ang kaha. Ilagay ang mga produkto sa order, tanggapin ang bayad, at i-print ang resibo.
ask: How do I make a sale?

Sales/OfflineTransactions.title: Offline sales
Sales/OfflineTransactions.en: Sales made while there was no internet. They are sent to the system once you are back online.
Sales/OfflineTransactions.tl: Mga benta habang walang internet. Ipapadala ang mga ito sa sistema kapag may internet na ulit.
ask: How do offline sales work?

SalesImport/Index.title: Import past sales
SalesImport/Index.en: Add old sales from a CSV file. Download the template, fill in one row per item, upload it, check the preview, then confirm. Sales are saved on their real dates.
SalesImport/Index.tl: Magdagdag ng mga lumang benta mula sa CSV file. I-download ang template, maglagay ng isang row kada item, i-upload, tingnan ang preview, at saka kumpirmahin. Mase-save ang mga benta sa tunay nilang petsa.
ask: How do I import my old sales?

SalesHistory/Index.title: Sales history
SalesHistory/Index.en: Every completed sale. Find a receipt, see what was sold, void a sale or export the list.
SalesHistory/Index.tl: Lahat ng natapos na benta. Hanapin ang resibo, tingnan ang nabenta, i-void ang benta, o i-export ang listahan.
ask: How do I find a past receipt?

VoidLog/Index.title: Voids
VoidLog/Index.en: Who voided which sale or item, when, and why. Use it to check for mistakes or misuse.
VoidLog/Index.tl: Sino ang nag-void ng benta o item, kailan, at bakit. Gamitin ito para makita ang mali o pang-aabuso.
ask: Who voided sales today?

Expenses/Index.title: Expenses
Expenses/Index.en: Money the business spends, like rent, electricity and salaries. Expenses paid in cash come out of the cash drawer.
Expenses/Index.tl: Mga ginagastos ng negosyo, gaya ng upa, kuryente at sahod. Ang gastos na binayaran ng cash ay ibabawas sa cash drawer.
ask: How do I record an expense?

Finance/Dashboard.title: Finance
Finance/Dashboard.en: Profit, cash and what the business owns and owes, all in one place.
Finance/Dashboard.tl: Kita, pera, at mga pag-aari at utang ng negosyo, makikita lahat dito.
ask: Am I making a profit this month?

Finance/CashFlow.title: Money in & out
Finance/CashFlow.en: Where money came from and where it went in a period. It explains why profit and cash on hand are different.
Finance/CashFlow.tl: Saan galing ang pera at saan napunta sa isang panahon. Ipinapaliwanag kung bakit magkaiba ang kita at ang hawak na pera.
ask: Why is my cash lower than my profit?

Finance/BalanceSheet.title: What you own & owe
Finance/BalanceSheet.en: What the business owns (cash, stock, equipment) and what it owes (bills, loans) on a given day.
Finance/BalanceSheet.tl: Ang mga pag-aari ng negosyo (pera, stock, gamit) at ang mga utang nito (bayarin, loan) sa isang araw.
ask: What does my balance sheet say?

Finance/Receivables.title: Customers' utang
Finance/Receivables.en: Money customers still owe the business, such as credit (utang), and which payments are late.
Finance/Receivables.tl: Pera na inuutang pa ng mga customer sa negosyo, gaya ng utang, at kung alin ang lampas na sa due date.
ask: Who owes me money?

Finance/Payables.title: Bills to pay
Finance/Payables.en: What the business owes suppliers. Record bills, see what is due soon and pay them.
Finance/Payables.tl: Mga utang ng negosyo sa mga supplier. Itala ang bill, tingnan ang malapit nang i-due, at bayaran ang mga ito.
ask: Which supplier bills are due?

Finance/OtherIncome.title: Other income
Finance/OtherIncome.en: Income that does not come from sales, like rent received or interest.
Finance/OtherIncome.tl: Kita na hindi galing sa benta, gaya ng natanggap na upa o interes.
ask: How do I record other income?

Finance/AssetsAndLoans.title: Bank, loans & equipment
Finance/AssetsAndLoans.en: Bank and e-wallet balances, loans and their repayments, equipment, and money the owner put in or took out.
Finance/AssetsAndLoans.tl: Balanse sa bangko at e-wallet, mga loan at bayad dito, mga gamit ng negosyo, at perang inilagay o kinuha ng may-ari.
ask: How do I record a loan?

Finance/MonthlyReviews.title: Monthly review
Finance/MonthlyReviews.en: A short review of each month compared with the month before: what went well, what needs attention, and what to do next.
Finance/MonthlyReviews.tl: Maikling pagsusuri ng bawat buwan kumpara sa nakaraang buwan: ano ang maganda, ano ang dapat ayusin, at ano ang susunod na gagawin.
ask: How did last month go?

Reports/ProfitLoss.title: Profit & loss
Reports/ProfitLoss.en: Sales minus the cost of goods and expenses, so you see if the business made or lost money in a period.
Reports/ProfitLoss.tl: Benta bawas ang puhunan sa paninda at gastos, para makita kung kumita o nalugi ang negosyo sa isang panahon.
ask: What is my profit this month?

Reports/VatReport.title: VAT report
Reports/VatReport.en: The VAT collected on sales for a period, ready to export for filing.
Reports/VatReport.tl: Ang VAT na nakolekta sa mga benta sa isang panahon, handang i-export para sa pag-file.
ask: How much VAT did I collect?

Wallet/Drawer.title: Today's drawer
Wallet/Drawer.en: How much cash should be in the drawer today. Set the opening cash, count the cash, and end the shift.
Wallet/Drawer.tl: Kung magkano dapat ang pera sa drawer ngayon. Ilagay ang panimulang pera, bilangin ang pera, at isara ang shift.
ask: Why is my drawer short?

Wallet/CashInOut.title: Cash in & out
Wallet/CashInOut.en: Every peso put into or taken out of the cash drawer, like float added, the owner taking cash, or expenses paid in cash.
Wallet/CashInOut.tl: Bawat pisong inilagay o kinuha sa cash drawer, gaya ng dagdag na barya, perang kinuha ng may-ari, o gastos na binayaran ng cash.
ask: How do I record cash taken by the owner?

Wallet/Balances.title: Where money is
Wallet/Balances.en: How much is in the cash drawer and in each payment channel, like GCash, a bank or a card terminal.
Wallet/Balances.tl: Kung magkano ang nasa cash drawer at sa bawat payment channel, gaya ng GCash, bangko o card terminal.
ask: How much is in GCash?

Wallet/History.title: Drawer history
Wallet/History.en: Past cash counts, changes to opening cash, and ended shifts, for checking back when the drawer did not match.
Wallet/History.tl: Mga nakaraang bilang ng pera, pagbabago sa panimulang pera, at mga isinarang shift, para masilip kapag hindi tugma ang drawer.
ask: When was the drawer last short?

Wallet/StoresCash.title: Stores' cash
Wallet/StoresCash.en: The shifts each store has ended: what was counted, what was expected, and the cash taken out.
Wallet/StoresCash.tl: Mga shift na isinara ng bawat store: ang nabilang, ang inaasahan, at ang perang kinuha.
ask: Which store was short this week?

Wallet/CardTerminals.title: Payment channels
Wallet/CardTerminals.en: The ways customers pay besides cash, like card terminals, GCash, Maya and banks. Add, edit or turn them off here.
Wallet/CardTerminals.tl: Mga paraan ng pagbayad bukod sa cash, gaya ng card terminal, GCash, Maya at bangko. Dito magdagdag, mag-edit o mag-off.
ask: How do I add GCash?

Wallet/CardTerminalMoneyDetails.title: Money received
Wallet/CardTerminalMoneyDetails.en: Every paid sale that came in through this payment channel, so you can match it with its app or statement.
Wallet/CardTerminalMoneyDetails.tl: Lahat ng bayad na benta na pumasok sa payment channel na ito, para maitugma sa app o statement nito.
ask: How much came in through this channel today?

Products/Index.title: Products
Products/Index.en: The items this store sells. Add, edit, set prices, and add an existing product to this store.
Products/Index.tl: Mga paninda ng store na ito. Magdagdag, mag-edit, maglagay ng presyo, at idagdag ang produkto mula sa ibang store.
ask: How do I change a price?

Products/Create.title: Add product
Products/Create.en: Create a new product: its name, price, cost, category and whether stock is tracked.
Products/Create.tl: Gumawa ng bagong produkto: pangalan, presyo, puhunan, kategorya, at kung bibilangin ang stock nito.
ask: What is the difference between price and cost?

Products/Edit.title: Edit product
Products/Edit.en: Change a product's details, like its price, cost, category or barcode.
Products/Edit.tl: Baguhin ang detalye ng produkto, gaya ng presyo, puhunan, kategorya o barcode.
ask: Will changing the price affect past sales?

Products/Modifiers.title: Modifiers
Products/Modifiers.en: Options customers can choose for a product, like size, sugar level or add-ons, with their extra price.
Products/Modifiers.tl: Mga pagpipilian ng customer para sa produkto, gaya ng laki, tamis o dagdag, kasama ang dagdag na presyo.
ask: How do I add sizes to a drink?

Categories/Index.title: Categories
Categories/Index.en: Groups for products, used on the sales screen and in reports.
Categories/Index.tl: Mga grupo ng produkto, ginagamit sa sales screen at sa mga report.
ask: How do I add a category?

Discounts/Index.title: Discounts
Discounts/Index.en: Promos and discounts the store can give, on items or on the whole order.
Discounts/Index.tl: Mga promo at discount na maibibigay ng store, sa item o sa buong order.
ask: How do I create a promo?

MandatoryDiscounts/Index.title: PWD, Senior & Student discounts
MandatoryDiscounts/Index.en: The discount rates required by law for PWD, Senior Citizens and students.
MandatoryDiscounts/Index.tl: Ang mga discount na itinakda ng batas para sa PWD, Senior Citizen at estudyante.
ask: How is the Senior discount computed?

Inventory/Index.title: Inventory
Inventory/Index.en: An overview of stock: what is running low, what is out, and the value of stock on hand.
Inventory/Index.tl: Buod ng stock: alin ang paubos na, alin ang ubos na, at magkano ang halaga ng stock na hawak.
ask: What is running low?

Inventory/Products.title: Stock levels
Inventory/Products.en: How many of each product are in each store. Receive deliveries and move stock between stores here.
Inventory/Products.tl: Ilan ang bawat produkto sa bawat store. Dito tumanggap ng delivery at maglipat ng stock sa ibang store.
ask: How do I receive stock?

Inventory/Movements.title: Stock movements
Inventory/Movements.en: Every change to stock: sales, deliveries, transfers and corrections, with who did it and when.
Inventory/Movements.tl: Bawat pagbabago sa stock: benta, delivery, paglipat at pagtama, kasama kung sino at kailan.
ask: Why did this product's stock go down?

Inventory/Valuation.title: Stock value
Inventory/Valuation.en: How much the stock on hand is worth, at cost and at selling price.
Inventory/Valuation.tl: Magkano ang halaga ng stock na hawak, sa puhunan at sa presyo ng benta.
ask: How much is my stock worth?

Inventory/Locations/Index.title: Stores & warehouses
Inventory/Locations/Index.en: The business's stores, branches and warehouses. Add one, update its details or choose the default.
Inventory/Locations/Index.tl: Mga store, branch at warehouse ng negosyo. Magdagdag, i-update ang detalye, o piliin ang default.
ask: How do I add a branch?

Inventory/Locations/Create.title: Add store
Inventory/Locations/Create.en: Add a new store, branch or warehouse. A store sells; a warehouse only keeps and moves stock.
Inventory/Locations/Create.tl: Magdagdag ng bagong store, branch o warehouse. Ang store ay nagbebenta; ang warehouse ay nag-iimbak at naglilipat lang ng stock.
ask: What is the difference between a store and a warehouse?

Inventory/Locations/Edit.title: Edit store
Inventory/Locations/Edit.en: Change a store's name, address, type or whether it is active.
Inventory/Locations/Edit.tl: Baguhin ang pangalan, address, uri ng store, o kung aktibo ito.
ask: What happens if I turn a store off?

Inventory/Locations/Show.title: Store details
Inventory/Locations/Show.en: One store's details, its stock and its staff.
Inventory/Locations/Show.tl: Detalye ng isang store, ang stock nito at ang mga tauhan nito.
ask: How is this store doing?

Inventory/StockAdjustments/Index.title: Stock adjustments
Inventory/StockAdjustments/Index.en: Corrections to stock for damaged, expired or lost items, or after a recount. Some need approval before they apply.
Inventory/StockAdjustments/Index.tl: Pagtama sa stock dahil sa sira, expired o nawalang item, o pagkatapos magbilang ulit. May mga kailangang aprubahan muna.
ask: How do I approve an adjustment?

Inventory/StockAdjustments/Create.title: New stock adjustment
Inventory/StockAdjustments/Create.en: Record a stock correction: which items, how many, and the reason.
Inventory/StockAdjustments/Create.tl: Itala ang pagtama sa stock: aling mga item, ilan, at ang dahilan.
ask: Which reason should I pick for expired items?

Inventory/StockAdjustments/Edit.title: Edit stock adjustment
Inventory/StockAdjustments/Edit.en: Change a draft stock correction before it is sent for approval.
Inventory/StockAdjustments/Edit.tl: Baguhin ang draft na pagtama sa stock bago ipadala para aprubahan.
ask: Who can approve this adjustment?

Purchasing/Index.title: Purchasing
Purchasing/Index.en: Orders to suppliers. When stock arrives, receive it: the stock goes up and the supplier bill is updated. You can pay right away from a store's cash drawer.
Purchasing/Index.tl: Mga order sa supplier. Pagdating ng stock, i-receive ito: tataas ang stock at maa-update ang bill ng supplier. Puwedeng bayaran agad mula sa cash drawer ng store.
ask: How do I pay a supplier when stock arrives?

Customers/Index.title: Customers
Customers/Index.en: The people who buy from the business: their details, purchases, loyalty points and credit.
Customers/Index.tl: Ang mga bumibili sa negosyo: kanilang detalye, mga binili, loyalty points at utang.
ask: Who are my best customers?

Credits/Index.title: Credit (utang)
Credits/Index.en: Customers who buy on credit: how much each owes, credit limits, and payments received.
Credits/Index.tl: Mga customer na umuutang: magkano ang utang ng bawat isa, ang credit limit, at mga bayad na natanggap.
ask: Who has overdue utang?

Credits/Show.title: Customer credit
Credits/Show.en: One customer's credit: what they owe, their unpaid sales and their payments.
Credits/Show.tl: Utang ng isang customer: magkano ang utang, mga hindi pa bayad na benta, at mga bayad niya.
ask: How do I record a payment on this utang?

Loyalty/Index.title: Loyalty
Loyalty/Index.en: Points customers earn when they buy, the tiers they reach, and adding or taking away points.
Loyalty/Index.tl: Mga puntos na nakukuha ng customer kapag bumibili, ang mga tier na naaabot nila, at pagdagdag o pagbawas ng puntos.
ask: How do customers earn points?

Users/Index.title: Users
Users/Index.en: The staff who use the system: add them, set their role and store, their PIN and their supervisor.
Users/Index.tl: Ang mga tauhang gumagamit ng sistema: idagdag sila, itakda ang role at store, ang PIN, at ang supervisor nila.
ask: How do I add a cashier?

Users/Show.title: User details
Users/Show.en: One staff member's details, role, store and recent activity.
Users/Show.tl: Detalye ng isang tauhan, ang kanyang role, store at mga ginawa kamakailan.
ask: What can this user do?

Users/Edit.title: Edit user
Users/Edit.en: Change a staff member's details, role or store.
Users/Edit.tl: Baguhin ang detalye, role o store ng isang tauhan.
ask: Which role should a cashier have?

Users/Hierarchy.title: Who reports to whom
Users/Hierarchy.en: The chain of supervisors: which staff report to which supervisor or manager.
Users/Hierarchy.tl: Ang hanay ng mga supervisor: sinong tauhan ang nasa ilalim ng aling supervisor o manager.
ask: How do I assign a supervisor?

Roles/Index.title: Roles
Roles/Index.en: Roles decide what staff can see and do, like cashier, supervisor or manager.
Roles/Index.tl: Ang role ang nagtatakda kung ano ang makikita at magagawa ng tauhan, gaya ng cashier, supervisor o manager.
ask: What can a manager do that a cashier can't?

Roles/Create.title: New role
Roles/Create.en: Create a role and choose which pages and actions it allows.
Roles/Create.tl: Gumawa ng role at piliin kung aling mga page at gawain ang pinapayagan nito.
ask: Which permissions does a cashier need?

Roles/Edit.title: Edit role
Roles/Edit.en: Change what a role allows. Everyone with this role is affected.
Roles/Edit.tl: Baguhin kung ano ang pinapayagan ng role. Apektado ang lahat ng may ganitong role.
ask: What will change for staff with this role?

Roles/Show.title: Role details
Roles/Show.en: What this role allows and who has it.
Roles/Show.tl: Kung ano ang pinapayagan ng role na ito at kung sino ang may hawak nito.
ask: Who has this role?

Roles/PermissionMatrix.title: Permission matrix
Roles/PermissionMatrix.en: All roles side by side, showing which permissions each one has.
Roles/PermissionMatrix.tl: Lahat ng role na magkakatabi, makikita kung aling mga pahintulot ang mayroon ang bawat isa.
ask: Which roles can void a sale?

Permissions/Index.title: Permissions
Permissions/Index.en: Every action in the system that can be allowed or blocked for a role.
Permissions/Index.tl: Bawat gawain sa sistema na puwedeng payagan o harangan para sa isang role.
ask: What does this permission allow?

Permissions/Show.title: Permission details
Permissions/Show.en: What this permission allows and which roles have it.
Permissions/Show.tl: Kung ano ang pinapayagan ng pahintulot na ito at kung aling mga role ang mayroon nito.
ask: Which roles have this permission?

Settings/Index.title: Settings
Settings/Index.en: How the business sells: VAT, receipts, and other selling options.
Settings/Index.tl: Kung paano nagbebenta ang negosyo: VAT, resibo, at iba pang setting sa pagbebenta.
ask: How do I turn on VAT?

AiUsage/Index.title: AI usage
AiUsage/Index.en: How much the AI assistant has been used, and how much of the plan's limit is left.
AiUsage/Index.tl: Gaano kadalas nagamit ang AI assistant, at magkano pa ang natitira sa limit ng plan.
ask: How many AI questions are left this month?

Billing/Gcash.title: Billing
Billing/Gcash.en: Pay for or upgrade your Techiko plan, and see past payments.
Billing/Gcash.tl: Bayaran o i-upgrade ang iyong Techiko plan, at tingnan ang mga nakaraang bayad.
ask: When is my plan due?

Billing/ManualPayments/Index.title: Manual payments
Billing/ManualPayments/Index.en: Plan payments sent by GCash or bank that need checking and approving.
Billing/ManualPayments/Index.tl: Mga bayad sa plan na ipinadala sa GCash o bangko na kailangang suriin at aprubahan.

Catalog/SharedProducts/Index.title: Shared products
Catalog/SharedProducts/Index.en: Products every business can copy from, so they don't have to type common items again.
Catalog/SharedProducts/Index.tl: Mga produktong puwedeng kopyahin ng lahat ng negosyo, para hindi na i-type ulit ang mga karaniwang item.

Catalog/SharedSuggestions/Index.title: Product suggestions
Catalog/SharedSuggestions/Index.en: Products businesses suggested adding to the shared catalog, waiting for review.
Catalog/SharedSuggestions/Index.tl: Mga produktong iminungkahi ng mga negosyo na idagdag sa shared catalog, naghihintay ng pagsusuri.

Domains/Index.title: Organizations
Domains/Index.en: Every business using Techiko: their plan, features and status.
Domains/Index.tl: Lahat ng negosyong gumagamit ng Techiko: ang kanilang plan, features at status.

Domains/Show.title: Organization details
Domains/Show.en: One business's plan, features, stores and users.
Domains/Show.tl: Ang plan, features, mga store at users ng isang negosyo.

Messages/Index.title: Messages
Messages/Index.en: Chats with businesses that need help or have questions.
Messages/Index.tl: Mga usapan kasama ang mga negosyong nangangailangan ng tulong o may tanong.

Messages/AssistantUnanswered.title: Unanswered questions
Messages/AssistantUnanswered.en: Questions the AI assistant could not answer, so the guides can be improved.
Messages/AssistantUnanswered.tl: Mga tanong na hindi nasagot ng AI assistant, para mapaganda ang mga gabay.

Plans/Index.title: Plans
Plans/Index.en: The plans businesses can subscribe to, with their prices and features.
Plans/Index.tl: Mga plan na puwedeng i-subscribe ng mga negosyo, kasama ang presyo at features.

Mail/Test.title: Test email
Mail/Test.en: Send a test email to check that the system can send mail.
Mail/Test.tl: Magpadala ng test email para masigurong nakakapagpadala ng email ang sistema.

Profile/Edit.title: Profile
Profile/Edit.en: Your own account: your name, email and password.
Profile/Edit.tl: Ang sarili mong account: pangalan, email at password.
ask: How do I change my password?

Domains/Create.title: New organization
Domains/Create.en: Set up a new business that will use Techiko: its name, address and settings.
Domains/Create.tl: Mag-set up ng bagong negosyong gagamit ng Techiko: pangalan, address at mga setting nito.

Domains/Edit.title: Edit organization
Domains/Edit.en: Change a business's name, address and settings.
Domains/Edit.tl: Baguhin ang pangalan, address at mga setting ng isang negosyo.

Timesheets/Index.title: Timesheets
Timesheets/Index.en: Who worked when, and the hours to pay. Staff clock in and out on the Sales page with their own PIN. Here you close a forgotten clock-out, add a missed shift, and export the hours for payroll.
Timesheets/Index.tl: Sino ang pumasok at kailan, at ilang oras ang babayaran. Nagta-time in at time out ang staff sa Sales page gamit ang sarili nilang PIN. Dito mo isasara ang nakalimutang time out, idaragdag ang shift na hindi na-record, at ie-export ang oras para sa sahod.
ask: How do I fix a forgotten clock-out?

DiningTables/Index.title: Tables
DiningTables/Index.en: For restaurants: turn dine-in on for a store, add its tables and drag them to where they stand. The Sales page there then gets a Tables button to open tabs by table or name, send orders to the kitchen, and move, merge or split them.
DiningTables/Index.tl: Para sa kainan: buksan ang dine-in sa isang store, idagdag ang mga mesa at i-drag sa tamang puwesto. Magkakaroon ang Sales page doon ng Tables button para magbukas ng tab ayon sa mesa o pangalan, magpadala ng order sa kusina, at maglipat, magsama o maghati ng tab.
ask: How do I open a tab for a table?
